summary: First full E2E run of Cadence CX (backend + frontend). Backend: 21/21 pytest pass (auth 401, /api/me roles, agent 403 on users/people/qa-forms/kb/coaching/trees/courses, agent scoping on interactions+coaching, role-in-body ignored, demote-last-admin 409, users role PATCH on a TEST_ user, QA form CRUD, AutoQA text scoring (~15-25s with Claude), auto-fail -> overall 0, real audio upload (OpenAI TTS-generated mp3) -> whisper transcript -> scored, dashboard, KB search logging/top searches/category filter/article CRUD w/ steps, Ask AI SSE with sources, public KB excludes kb-disclosure, public ask SSE, decision tree CRUD + 400 on bad links/start, AI tree generation, course CRUD, AI quiz generation, quiz attempt score/review, answers hidden for agent, coaching CRUD + agent toggle own only). Frontend (Clerk ticket sign-in, admin + agent): dashboard KPIs/charts/leaderboard/top searches, Evaluate interaction (paste transcript) -> live status -> AUTO-FAIL detail with flags/rubric/summary/recommended KB links, Create coaching session from interaction (prefilled agent, focus, notes, 6 action items, recommended articles checked) + course assign + save + toggle item, Knowledge search/category/Ask AI streaming/article create with visual step image, tree runner (options/back/restart/copy script), tree editor create, AI tree generation from SOP, QA form create with weight+auto-fail and delete, Users & Roles table with role selects, course editor + AI quiz (5 q) + save, agent view (restricted nav, no staff buttons, /users shows 'Admins only', coaching toggle, quiz 100% pass, attempts table), public /help list/search/Ask AI/article view, kb-disclosure not found publicly, unauth /dashboard -> /sign-in. No functional bugs found; only minor/UX items.

minor.issue: Uses the agent-facing ANSWER_SYSTEM prompt, so public customer answers are phrased for agents ('To help a customer who forgot their password... Verify identity: ask for...') and even says 'If you're a customer rather than an agent, contact support'. Use a customer-facing system prompt for the public endpoint.
QuizQ.answer_index not validated against options length (can save answer_index out of range -> unanswerable question).
Returns the doc before $inc so 'views' in response is stale by 1 (cosmetic).
agent_id not validated against users; a typo'd/unknown agent_id silently creates a session nobody can see as agent.

issues: Charts render as blank axes and KPIs show '0%' / '0/5' instead of an empty state or '—' when the agent has no scored interactions
'Scheduled for' uses native browser datetime-local picker instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover
Delete uses window.confirm instead of a shadcn AlertDialog (same on QA form/article delete)
When created from an interaction where all criteria fail, Focus is prefilled with ALL criterion names concatenated (very long title); consider top 1-2 lowest-scoring
genQuiz uses stale closure setC({...c, quiz:[...c.quiz, ...r.data]}) — edits made while AI is generating (10-30s) are overwritten; use functional setState

action_items: Give /api/public/ask a customer-facing system prompt (speak to the customer, not the agent)
Use functional setState in Course.jsx genQuiz to avoid losing edits
Replace native datetime-local in Coaching dialog with shadcn date/time picker; consider AlertDialog for deletes
Add empty states on dashboard charts/KPIs when no data
critical_code_review_comments: tests/make_test_users.py: email lookup was not URL-encoded ('+' became space) -> user not found -> POST /users 422 on every rerun. Fixed by urllib.parse.quote (test helper only).
server.py is 696 lines — near the 700-line limit; consider splitting routers (qa/interactions, kb, trees, training, coaching).
dashboard 'pending' count and kb_searches aggregation are not env-scoped (minor).
Background scoring tasks are in-memory (_tasks); a backend restart mid-scoring leaves interactions stuck in 'scoring' with no recovery/timeout — consider a startup sweep marking stale ones failed.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md; tokens/tickets via `python tests/make_test_users.py --ticket` (tickets are single-use: regenerate before each browser session).
seed_data_creation: None. All TEST_ records (interactions, forms, articles, trees, courses, coaching, one quiz attempt, temp TEST_user) deleted by id. kb_searches entries from test queries (e.g. 'refund', 'password', 'billing') remain in the log and appear in dashboard Top searches. Pre-existing 'Test Agent' interaction (not created by me) still exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python tests/make_test_users.py --ticket` then `pytest tests/test_cadence_api.py`. Audio test needs /tmp/test_call.mp3 (generate with OpenAITextToSpeech from emergentintegrations; skipped if absent). UI login: <url>/sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<ticket>; tickets single-use. Only one admin in preview env (demote test hits 409). AI scoring took ~15-25s.
